kernel: compile ramfs standard so it is actually built

The options RAMFS / optional ramfs selection was not honoured by the CI config, so the 0090 kernel had no ramfs symbols. Compile the ramfs sources as standard files (like the other SWEET drivers) and gate registration only on the sweet_ramfs=1 boot-arg.

head_commit.message:
kernel: port HackiOS ramfs (opt-in via sweet_ramfs=1)

Selective port of oosexgang/hackios-xnu-kernel's in-memory ramfs (xnu/patches/0090). Registered through vfs_fsadd but gated behind boot-arg sweet_ramfs=1, so the default HFS+ /private/var data volume is not shadowed by a fresh empty ramfs at init.
